elsewhere.note: His archers surround me. He splits my kidneys apart, and does not spare. He pours out my bile on the ground.
As an archer who wounds all, so is he who hires a fool or he who hires those who pass by.
“Call together the archers against Babylon, all those who bend the bow. Encamp against her all around. Let none of it escape. Pay her back according to her…
